name: Beef & Mushroom Noodle Stir-Fry
method: Cook the noodles to the packet instructions, drain and set aside.
Fry the sliced beef in half the oil over a high heat for 2 minutes, then lift out.
Soften the sliced onion, mushrooms and garlic in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes, then add the stir-fry vegetables for 2 minutes.
Return the beef, add the noodles, soy sauce and vinegar and toss for a minute. Top with sliced spring onion.
